issues.message: No inspected official MOD Pizza source publishes protein, carbohydrates or fat. Only calories are imported; the other core macros are left empty and MOD Pizza cannot be published until an official macro specification is obtained.
The ordering site states topping calories apply to a one-topping pizza and may be lower on multi-topping pizzas. Summed builder totals are unverified.

The national menu labels salad sizes MINI / MOD / MEGA while ordering uses Small / Regular / Large. National salad and signature-pizza calorie totals name no size, so they are not linked to any variant.
Italian Chop: the national menu description omits chickpeas; the Hamburg ordering description includes them.
Catalog comes from two sampled stores (4080, 4168). It is not a national census; catering was not inspected.
Component ingredient and allergen declarations (modpizza.com/allergen) are not imported in this version.
